# Accessibility Statement

ZeroLabz is committed to ensuring our Web3 infrastructure and developer tools are accessible to all engineers.

## Supported Environments
- The CLI outputs and terminal logs for `unigas-guardian` are optimized for text-to-speech readability and screen readers.
- Documentation and dashboard integrations adhere to high-contrast and keyboard navigation standards.

## Reporting Issues
If you encounter any accessibility barriers within our tools, please report them to **dev@zrolabz.com**.
